description: Implementation of GroupRolesReadPlatformService for retrieving group role data from the database, including methods to retrieve multiple roles and a specific role by ID.

classes.name: GroupRolesReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to read group roles from the database.

classes.name: GroupRolesDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set to GroupRoleData objects.

methods.name: retrieveGroupRoles
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of group roles for a given group ID.

methods.name: retrieveGroupRole
methods.description: Retrieves a specific group role by group ID and role ID, throws exception if not found.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string used in queries.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a GroupRoleData object.
